question: Does deep-skin linear slab phase converge to the independent analytic solution?
stale_reason: covered root pyproject dependency metadata changed (platform markers for aarch64/arm64 only; x86 resolution unchanged); this change
claim: The fixed-grid deep-skin slab phase error decreases monotonically with every q>=1.5 and finest relative error<=0.003.

conditions.problem: Linear constant-mu slab; a=0.005m,222kHz,sigma=5e6S/m,mu_r=100,H0=1000A/m; exp(+j omega t)
conditions.mesh: Fixed smooth depth grading N25/49/97/193/385; h_max and h_min/delta recorded
conditions.hardware: CPU double precision, one library thread

comparison.reference: Analytic slab diffusion solution with centre symmetry; https://web.mit.edu/6.013_book/www/chapter10/10.7.html
comparison.independence: Closed-form diffusion reference and independent reviewer recomputation from recorded fields; no use of production solver as reference. Deep-skin regime does not validate finite-thickness effects.

reference.citation: Canonical bibliography key haus1989electromagnetic: Haus and Melcher, Electromagnetic Fields and Energy (1989), ISBN 9780132490207, section 10.7, https://web.mit.edu/6.013_book/www/chapter10/10.7.html ; symmetric-boundary specialization verified in the attached derivation.

quantity.name: relative complex L2 magnetic-field error
quantity.definition: sqrt(integral |H_FE-H_exact|^2 dx / integral |H_exact|^2 dx), elementwise 32-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature of the P1 interpolant

variables.h_max_over_half_depth: Actual maximum element width divided by fixed slab half-depth a; only this refinement axis varies

expected_theory.model: Asymptotic second-order expectation for smooth constant-coefficient diffusion on uniformly refined smooth depth grading; q>=1.5 is the approved empirical lower bound
expected_theory.norm: relative complex L2 of the P1 field interpolant
expected_theory.source: Analytic ODE and boundary verification in reference-verification.md; approved fixed-grid experiment
expected_theory.assumptions: Fixed smooth grading refined over the entire half-depth; fixed positive real mu/sigma, a/frequency/H0; no roundoff plateau
expected_theory.limitations: Deep-skin a/delta about105 only; h_max in negligible-field interior, h_min/delta halves too. No general adaptive-mesh, finite-thickness, nonlinear, GPU or full-coil order claim.

criterion.failure_definition: FAIL if errors are not strictly decreasing, any adjacent actual-h_max rate is below1.5, the finest error exceeds0.003, or any true residual exceeds1e-6. An unchanged mesh coordinate or zero/roundoff plateau is UNRESOLVED, never a fabricated rate or waiver.

rationale.inference: The independently checked fixed-grid A ladder satisfies the declared deep-skin linear slab criterion. This is a scoped adoption, not whole-IH or release qualification.
rationale.scope: Constant real mu/sigma; half-depth0.005m,222kHz,mu_r100,sigma5e6S/m,H0=1000A/m; a/delta about105. Finite-thickness/midplane, nonlinear BH, fullcoil, GPU and FEM remain outside this evidence.

assumptions.statement: The analytic reference solves the declared exp(+j omega t) equation and symmetric boundary conditions; its conjugate is not valid under that convention.
assumptions.recheck: Independently review the algebraic derivation and original reference evaluation; reconsider both Z and phase adoption if the equation, boundary or convention changes.

assumptions.statement: The A25..385 series refines the entire fixed smooth grading at fixed a/material/drive. h_max/a is the approved rate coordinate; h_min/delta is recorded to expose the skin-layer resolution.
assumptions.recheck: Reconsider all dependent adoption claims on changed physical regime, grid grading, refinement policy or unexplained plateau; do not transfer these orders to adaptive B.

assumptions.statement: Saved exact-source clean computations were compared with an analytic reference and independently recomputed by the reviewer; the production solver is not its own analytic oracle.
assumptions.recheck: Check original source/mesh/result identities and independent recomputation before re-certification; an archive hash alone is not numerical verification.

assumptions.statement: The A25 surrogate uses the adopted fixed-grid production entry point and historical ReZ/phase values. Both conductance mutations change the phase sensor; the explicit negative phase assertion remains. The impedance-only sign survivor remains disclosed.
assumptions.recheck: Review production-path coverage and mutation sensitivity after any guard/baseline/grading change. Tolerance is user-approved1e-9 with zero atol; never infer accuracy from this coarse lock.

break_conditions.condition: ODE, boundary, phase convention or analytic reference derivation is found incorrect
Material, excitation, regime, grid/refinement contract or rate applicability changes
Original identity or independent-oracle/reviewer evidence is contradicted or covered source changes
Production path, coarse model, phase sign guard or mutation sensitivity changes or required mutation survives
